guard.name: Guard
guard.description: Brace: this monster takes 75% less damage this round.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.description: Shield the whole team: every ally takes 50% less damage this round.

focus.name: Focus
focus.description: Raise own attack for the rest of the fight.

rally.name: Rally Cry
rally.description: Raise the attack of every ally in the fight.

tectonic.name: Tectonic Smash
tectonic.description: Splits the ground beneath the foe.

harden.name: Harden
harden.description: Raise own defense for the rest of the fight.

soothing_rain.name: Soothing Rain
soothing_rain.description: Heal every ally by 20% of their max HP.

prism_crush.name: Prism Crush
prism_crush.description: Crystal shards erupt around the foe.

thunder_crown.name: Thunder Crown
thunder_crown.description: ★5 signature: a crown of lightning strikes every foe.

mountain_fall.name: Mountain Fall
mountain_fall.description: ★5 signature: a mountainside crashes onto every foe.

tsunami.name: Tsunami
tsunami.description: ★5 signature: a towering wave sweeps every foe away.

aurora_veil.name: Aurora Veil
aurora_veil.description: Every ally takes 65% less damage this round and heals 10%.

volt_dash.name: Volt Dash
volt_dash.description: A lightning-fast tackle that strikes before normal moves.

charge_up.name: Charge Up
charge_up.description: Store electricity: raises own attack and speed.

thunder_clap.name: Thunder Clap
thunder_clap.description: A deafening crack that hits every foe and slows them.

ion_storm.name: Ion Storm
ion_storm.description: A colossal discharge. The user takes 25% of the damage dealt.

gem_shard.name: Gem Shard
gem_shard.description: Flicks a razor gem that strikes first.

sandblast.name: Sandblast
sandblast.description: Grit in the eyes: damages and lowers the target's attack.

bastion.name: Bastion
bastion.description: Raise the defense of every ally for the rest of the fight.

landslide_fury.name: Landslide Fury
landslide_fury.description: Brings the mountain down. The user takes 30% of the damage dealt.

aqua_drain.name: Aqua Drain
aqua_drain.description: Siphons water from the foe: heals 50% of the damage dealt.

riptide.name: Riptide
riptide.description: A churning current that hits every foe and slows them.

healing_tide.name: Healing Tide
healing_tide.description: Restore 50% of max HP (healing fatigue applies).

intimidate.name: Intimidate
intimidate.description: A fearsome glare that lowers every foe's attack.

lions_thunder.name: Lion's Thunder
lions_thunder.description: ★3 signature: a roar that falls as a lightning bolt.

magnet_ram.name: Magnet Ram
magnet_ram.description: ★3 signature: a magnetised charge that also lowers the target's defense.

quagmire.name: Quagmire
quagmire.description: ★3 signature: turns the ground to sucking mud under every foe.

abyssal_coil.name: Abyssal Coil
abyssal_coil.description: ★3 signature: crushes the foe in the deep. Heals 30% of the damage.

storm_glide.name: Storm Glide
storm_glide.description: ★3 signature: a lightning-fast glide that strikes first.

overload_core.name: Overload Core
overload_core.description: ★4 signature: vents the reactor core over every foe.

tectonic_roar.name: Tectonic Roar
tectonic_roar.description: ★4 signature: the mountains answer. Hits every foe and cracks their defense.

tidal_bastion.name: Tidal Bastion
tidal_bastion.description: ★4 signature: raises the sunken walls. Every ally takes 60% less damage this round and heals 15%.

oceans_wrath.name: Ocean's Wrath
oceans_wrath.description: ★4 signature: the whole sea, in one blow.

eye_of_the_storm.name: Eye of the Storm
eye_of_the_storm.description: ★4 signature: a hurricane that hits every foe and heals 20% of the damage.
